name: Barricade
description: Free, but limited. Block a lane and steer the ground enemies into the traps you have waiting.
alt: In-game screenshot of Brickhold's Barricade defense.

name: Spike Trap
description: Stakes shoot up from the floor. Bend the route across them and give the next wave a nasty surprise.
alt: In-game screenshot of Brickhold's Spike Trap defense.

name: Brimstone
description: Sets enemies on fire as they cross the tile. A warm welcome for anything coming through the portal.
alt: In-game screenshot of Brickhold's Brimstone defense.

name: Arrow Wall
description: Volleys of arrows fly across the lane. Put those castle walls to work.
alt: In-game screenshot of Brickhold's Arrow Wall defense.

name: Ripsaw
description: Saw blades run along the wall. Give the horde a route that keeps them close enough to regret it.
alt: In-game screenshot of Brickhold's Ripsaw defense.

name: Bouncing Boulder
description: Bowls enemies over with a bouncing boulder. The lane is about to get a lot less orderly.
alt: In-game screenshot of Brickhold's Bouncing Boulder defense.

name: Auto Ballista
description: A ceiling turret that aims itself. Give it a clear view and let it get to work.
alt: In-game screenshot of Brickhold's Auto Ballista defense.

name: Haymaker
description: Spinning hammers turn the lane beneath this ceiling trap into a very unfortunate place to stand.
alt: In-game screenshot of Brickhold's Haymaker defense.

name: Skeleton
description: The portal's regular. Marches straight for the crystal, unless your carefully placed traps have something to say about it.
alt: In-game screenshot of Brickhold's Skeleton enemy.

name: Medium Skeleton
description: A tougher skeleton carrying a sword. Another reason to make that trap lane count.
alt: In-game screenshot of Brickhold's Medium Skeleton enemy.

name: Armoured Skeleton
description: Armoured, armed, and carrying a shield. This skeleton brings a halberd to the party.
alt: In-game screenshot of Brickhold's Armoured Skeleton enemy.

name: Skeleton Archer
description: Shoots heroes from range. Don't let the front line distract you from the archer behind it.
alt: In-game screenshot of Brickhold's Skeleton Archer enemy.

name: Wargling
description: Fast on four feet, fragile when you catch it. Blink and it may already be past your plan.
alt: In-game screenshot of Brickhold's Wargling enemy.

name: Ghost
description: Floats over your floor traps. Bring something that can reach it in the air.
alt: In-game screenshot of Brickhold's Ghost enemy.

name: Bat Mage
description: Casts magical projectiles that follow the heroes. Keep an eye on your timing and your way out.
alt: In-game screenshot of Brickhold's Bat Mage enemy.

name: Gargoyle
description: A flying stone bruiser. Your floor traps will need a little help with this one.
alt: In-game screenshot of Brickhold's Gargoyle enemy.

name: Werewolf Hunter
description: The crystal can wait. This hunter is interested in the heroes running around beside it.
alt: In-game screenshot of Brickhold's Werewolf Hunter enemy.

name: Troll
description: Huge, slow, and very hard to ignore. The troll is happy to break a barricade that gets in its way.
alt: In-game screenshot of Brickhold's Troll enemy.

name: Shield Brute
description: Carries a shield that blocks hits from the front. Find a way around it or strike from underneath.
alt: In-game screenshot of Brickhold's Shield Brute enemy.
